meta.name: perf-theory-tester
meta.description: Use when running controlled perf experiments to validate hypotheses.

copy.tagline: 运行性能实验验证假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过控制实验验证性能假设
copy.tagline_en: Run controlled performance experiments to validate hypotheses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate performance hypotheses through controlled experiments

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会按照严格的实验流程测试性能假设：先确认基线干净，然后只应用一个改动，运行至少两次验证，最后回退基线。输出包含假设ID、改动摘要、指标变化和接受/拒绝/不确定的结论。
howto.when: 当你需要验证某个性能优化假设，要求进行受控实验时触发。

say.text: 测试一下把缓存大小翻倍对响应时间的影响。
say.note: Claude 会执行单变量实验并给出结论。

say.text: 验证关闭日志压缩能否降低CPU使用率。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤运行实验并记录证据。

howto.what_en: Claude runs controlled perf experiments: confirms clean baseline, applies one change, runs 2+ validation passes, reverts baseline. Outputs hypothesis ID, change summary, delta metrics, and verdict (accept/reject/inconclusive).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate a performance hypothesis via controlled experiments.

say_en.text: Test the impact of doubling cache size on response time.
say_en.note: Claude runs a single-variable experiment and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Verify whether disabling log compression reduces CPU usage.
say_en.note: Claude follows the steps and records evidence.
